# Depictio Documentation

> Documentation for Depictio

Depictio turns bioinformatics pipeline results into interactive, shareable dashboards: a FastAPI backend, a React viewer, MongoDB, S3 storage and a Python CLI that ingests results. Every CLI command and option is also available as JSON at depictio-cli/cli-reference.json.


## Start

- [Home](https://depictio.github.io/depictio-docs/latest/index.md): What depictio is, with the main features
- [Getting Started](https://depictio.github.io/depictio-docs/latest/usage/get_started/index.md): First steps, from install to a first dashboard
- [Tutorials](https://depictio.github.io/depictio-docs/latest/tutorials/index.md): Tutorials
